title: Gated Q-learning: Add Off-Policy Bias to Taste
abstract: arXiv:2607.28916v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multistep credit assignment is critical for sample-efficient reinforcement learning, yet managing off-policy bias in Q-learning remains a fundamental challenge. For 30 years, practitioners have been limited to a binary choice: eliminate the bias at the cost of severely truncated eligibility traces (Watkins' Q($\lambda$)), or ignore the bias to learn faster while injecting detrimental errors into the value estimates (Peng's Q($\lambda$)). Modern off-policy estimators fail to resolve this tension, as importance-sampling ratios collapse under Q-learning's greedy target policy. We introduce Gated Q-learning, a novel algorithmic framework that ends this dilemma by smoothly interpolating between the two historical extremes. Rather than relying on importance sampling, our approach employs a continuous, state-action-dependent gating mechanism to selectively attenuate eligibility traces in an exploration-aware manner. translated_title: 门控Q学习：随心调节离策略偏差
translated_abstract: 多步信用分配对于样本高效的强化学习至关重要，然而如何在Q学习中管理离策略偏差始终是一个根本性挑战。30年来，实践者一直只能在做二选一的抉择：要么以严重截断资格迹为代价彻底消除偏差（Watkins的Q(λ)），要么为了更快学习而忽略偏差、但将有害误差注入价值估计之中（Peng的Q(λ)）。现代离策略估计器无法化解这一矛盾，因为重要性采样比率在Q学习的贪婪目标策略下会失效。我们提出了门控Q学习，一种新颖的算法框架，通过在上述两个历史极端之间平滑插值，终结了这一困境。我们的方法不依赖重要性采样，而是采用一种连续的、依赖状态-动作的门控机制，以感知探索的方式选择性地衰减资格迹。我们提供了严格的理论（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出门控Q学习框架，通过连续的、状态-动作相关的门控机制以感知探索的方式选择性衰减资格迹，在Watkins与Peng的Q(λ)两个历史极端之间平滑插值，解决了Q学习中离策略偏差与学习效率之间长达30年的两难权衡。
en_tdlr: Gated Q-learning introduces a continuous, state-action-dependent gating mechanism that selectively attenuates eligibility traces in an exploration-aware manner, smoothly interpolating between Watkins' and Peng's Q(λ) to resolve the 30-year-old dilemma between off-policy bias and learning speed in Q-learning.
